Flags

    Where denials run above normal

    Each cell compares that week's denial rate with the same row's previous 8 weeks. Darker means further above its own normal. Hover a cell for the numbers, or select it to jump to that week.

    At or below normal 4× normal or more

    Would this have caught Emblem?

    Spike

    This week's denied lines for a slice (payer, provider, CPT, location, category, reason code, or a pair of these) are at least 2.5× what its own last 8 weeks predict, with at least 6 lines and a less than 1-in-1,000 chance of being random noise.

    Rising

    The last 4 weeks together run at least 2.5× the 8 weeks before them, and at least 3 of those 4 weeks were elevated. This catches slow build-ups that never look dramatic in a single week.

    Outlier

    A payer or provider denies for a specific reason at 4× or more the rate seen everywhere else that week. This works from the first week of data, before any history exists.

    How the numbers are counted

    One posted line counts once, even if it carries several denial codes. Duplicate IGNORE/WRITE_OFF rows are merged. Primary and secondary claims are tracked separately. Flags under $500 are hidden. Lines denied are payer-categorized adjustments other than Adjudication with a positive amount.
